summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth; blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Ordinary growth may continue only where existing consent, cookie/analytics disclosure, affiliate disclosure, claims, provenance, rights, and platform-policy boundaries are preserved. Do not treat incomplete telemetry as a blocker or invent telemetry. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown; site-specific failures require remediation or evidence before affected launches. Revenue is partial: 2026-09-21 only, $4.92 aggregate commission, $0 site-attributed; ROI, margin, causal lift, and operational health remain unknown. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private; permit only bounded read-only evidence work and unsent permission-request preparation. Do not expose publicly, monetize, expand alerts, enable new tracking, deploy, or send external outreach.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed. No task may close because complete evidence is absent. Progress: official API documentation, public terms/support pages, backend/api/main.py, backend/services/fetcher.py, config.yml, privacy/cookie pages, and draft terms are recorded. Source rights remain blocked; data-flow and privacy evidence remain partial; logs/vendors/incident evidence remains incomplete. Next evidence action: attach one read-only evidence bundle covering alert fields and identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent/unsubscribe, GA4 consent/settings/retention, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures; separately maintain the field-level rights matrix and unsent permission-request package for owner and human-counsel review.

Data-use review decisions: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked. Missing written permission/API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, caching/display/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price-use limits, and affiliate/advertising permission. Smallest action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package to human counsel and the owner. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest action: produce the repository/deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent/withdrawal evidence, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdiction-specific review. Smallest action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-subject request procedures. Smallest action: produce a read-only operator/vendor and incident inventory. No item is clear or conditional for public launch on current evidence.

Private-site decision: keep SearchWoot private. Reconsider only after authoritative source permission, field-level rights, freshness/correction/takedown controls, alert-data retention and user workflows, deployed consent and GA4 evidence, log/vendor/incident evidence, accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, security/release, and owner gates are complete. Human counsel is required before relying on upstream permission, applying jurisdiction-specific privacy conclusions, or expanding affiliate/advertising use.

Retain existing containment, measurement, failure-review, and bounded security-evidence work only. Do not create new proposals, experiments, telemetry requests, spend, monetization, production changes, or launch activity this cycle. Requeue failed work only after documented deduplication, ownership, root cause, isolated validation, rollback, and explicit requeue-or-close evidence.
